text:
raj: FYI OrchidBank wants multi-cloud BYOK (AWS + GCP) and automatic rewrap on rotation. Setting up onboarding this morning.
kevin_orchid: Ran the quickstart and upload failed with error "invalid_envelope_format". Posting minimal client config we used:
kevin_orchid: ```provider: redwood
kms:
  aws_key_id: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-1234
  gcp_key_name: projects/xyz/locations/global/keyRings/rk/cryptoKeys/ck
  envelope: AES256-GCM
  rotation_window_days: 90
```
marta: Did the client include our RW-ENC:v1 header? Our ingestion needs the prefix to select unwrap path; we expect 12-byte nonce + 16-byte tag for AES-GCM.
kevin_orchid: No prefix from client, we just uploaded raw ciphertext.
emma: That matches the error. Docs mention RW-ENC but it's easy to miss. I'll add a troubleshooting snippet to the quickstart. @raj can you track a docs PR?
raj: Will do. Also need to confirm RBAC checks for multi-cloud keys before we finish onboarding.
marta: AWS key policy needs kms:Decrypt, kms:Encrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:DescribeKey (and kms:ReEncrypt if you want cross-region rewrap). GCP needs roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on the runtime SA and cloudkms audit logs enabled. Azure needs UnwrapKey + Get on the key for the service principal and Key Vault logging on.
emma: Also require CloudTrail / Cloud Audit logging retention for key ops; we look for Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey events during preflight.
raj: kms-bot, run BYOK preflight for tenant=orchidbank.
kms-bot: preflight started for tenant=orchidbank
kms-bot: aws: missing permission kms:GenerateDataKey on arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-1234
kms-bot: gcp: audit logs not found for cloudkms.googleapis.com in last 7d
kevin_orchid: Confirmed our IAM role had a generic policy but not a key-specific grant; we'll add GenerateDataKey and enable audit logs.
kevin_orchid: Quick question on rotation: they plan 90-day master key rotation and want our runtime to rewrap envelopes automatically. How does that work?
marta: We support automatic rewrap when key metadata indicates rotation. Customers must allow rewrap in key policy (AWS: kms:ReEncrypt; GCP: permissions to update primary version). Our background job will call GenerateDataKey/Encrypt and re-encrypt envelopes to new key version. We also expose an API to trigger a manual rewrap.
emma: Compliance note: advise adding key policy denies for key export, require MFA for deletion, and alerting on failed decrypt spikes. Also ensure audit logs stream to the customer's SIEM.
raj: Action items: 1) kevin will add GenerateDataKey grant and enable cloud audit logs; 2) emma will draft RW-ENC troubleshooting snippet; 3) marta will paste minimal IAM snippets for AWS/GCP/Azure into onboarding docs.
marta: Pasting minimal snippets for onboarding checklist:
AWS key policy snippet:
```{
  "Sid": "AllowRedwoodUse",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::222233334444:role/redwood-runtime"},
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:ReEncrypt","kms:DescribeKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}```
GCP IAM binding example:
```- role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
  members:
  - serviceAccount:redwood-runtime@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
Azure note: grant Key Unwrap & Get to the service principal and enable Key Vault logging / diagnostic settings.
emma: Can we add preflight checks for missing GenerateDataKey and missing audit logs?
raj: Yes, adding both checks to kms-bot rules and onboarding checklist.
kevin_orchid: Infra updated: added GenerateDataKey grant and enabled cloud audit logs. Re-running preflight.
kms-bot: preflight passed for tenant=orchidbank
kevin_orchid: Green ✅ thanks everyone, will follow up if anything else pops up.
